frozen_manifest.prerequisite: Current candidate effect criterion passed both fixtures and page policy N1 terminal; no concurrent/load trial authorized by this diagnostic
frozen_manifest.question: DjangoClient controls ~1s with sporadic coarse-stage spikes vs normal digest ~30ms. Measure real same-code serial Gunicorn service and GC intervals in separate worker/fixture processes; do not assume cause or next backend refactor.
frozen_manifest.scenario: 10000 repeated/diverse, identical remaining cardinalities, owned PostgreSQL/media, ANALYZE own tables. Four DjangoClient listing plain/GC pairs with policy unchanged. Gunicorn4 sync localTCP, six first-hit ESEN routes then four plain/observed pairs each; max one outstanding request, no RPS/arrival schedule/uploads.
frozen_manifest.criteria: Complete terminal run, same status/body/count, observed routes projection/native appropriate, source fingerprint unchanged, GC policy unchanged, all owned processes/databases/media cleaned. Serial control medians and WSGI/SQL/render/GC report scope/absence; not PASS of load nor causal overhead.
frozen_manifest.decision: Confront measured server service of actual mixture with unchanged theoretical occupancy reference; choose remaining mechanism from actual evidence. Never treat GC fixture/generator correction as backend improvement or subtract overlapping events. No matrix/common N2/capacity substitute.

worker_events.scope: WSGI entry/end and phase snapshots of identified synthetic requests. Partial snapshots are lower-bound observed work, not inferred zeros. Phase/SQL/thread CPU timings include instrumentation and overlap, never sum as a request partition. WSGI entry is not TCP accept; end includes response.close. No raw URI, headers, body, SQL or parameters stored; PostgreSQL CPU/rows/RSS/waits/locks/IO and causal observer overhead not_measured.

serial_runtime.scope: 10000 current-code synthetic records, repeated/diverse separately; own PG/media, ANALYZE preparation. DjangoClient four plain/GC callback pairs on listing in fixture process, no forced collections or policy changes. Fresh Gunicorn4 sync processes then six first-hit route probes and four AB/BA plain/observed pairs per ES/EN listing/search/detail. At most one HTTP request outstanding: NO arrival rate, uploads, concurrency or capacity acceptance. Normal stack remains, shared host/PG caches not reset. Plain runtime controls have no request-ID event collection or active GC callback; installed hook dispatch remains, causal overhead not_measured. Observed WSGI/SQL/render/route events use existing route-only hooks, with GC callbacks around application invocation EXCLUDING response iteration/close; no native rule replacements. GC intervals overlap request/SQL/render, never subtracted as predicted saving; heap provenance/causal comparison across DjangoClient and Gunicorn not_measured. Plain route itself not_measured, observed routes directly verified; body/count/status equivalence and existing nonwrapping route checks reused. SQL execute excludes fetch and is not DB CPU. Signed detail token authenticated and current binding checked before replacing it; all other bytes exact. Normalized SQL and separate plans reused from prior same backend, not relabeled as runtime samples.
not_measured: per-rule validation and model counts in this run
